title: Mexican Chicken Fajitas
description: A flavorful and spicy dish made with chicken, peppers, onions, and a hint of cumin. Serve with warm flour tortillas and your favorite toppings.

ingredients.name: 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken breast, cut into thin strips
Optional toppings: avocado, sour cream, shredded cheese, cilantro, salsa

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the sliced onions and bell peppers to the skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cumin, chili powder, paprika, and cayenne pepper to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables and spices.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Warm the flour tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the fajitas by placing a portion of the chicken and vegetable mixture onto a tortilla and topping with your desired toppings.
